name: jike
description: Jike (即刻) social network client for Codex agents: QR login, feed, posts, comments, search, notifications, and full-history export.

interface.shortDescription: Jike client for QR login, feeds, posts, search, and export.
interface.longDescription: Use Jike to authenticate by QR scan, browse feeds, create and delete posts, manage comments, search content or users, check notifications, and export complete Jike post histories from Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use Jike to authenticate with a QR scan and read my following feed.
Use Jike to search posts about AI and summarise the results.
Use Jike to export a user's full post history to Markdown.
